primaryTextRead.text: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.section: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list, “Jozabad” entry, lines 4388–4396: explicitly identifies 2 Chronicles 31:13 as an overseer in the Temple in Hezekiah’s time, and notes a possible link to 35:9.
